parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL223 (Alpha-1D adrenergic receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
